verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community user calling Salesforce 'king' of the customizations a CRM eventually needs (comm-6). Developer tooling such as scratch orgs and local deployment (gh-1, comm-3) supports a customization workflow. The pack never documents custom objects, custom fields, or relationships beyond the standard Lead/Account/Contact/Opportunity objects. missing for 10: first-party docs on custom object creation, custom field types, lookup/master-detail relationships, and hands-on corroboration of data-model extension.
